what_it_is.prose: This card groups aerospace structural-fastener families. Hi-Lok pin fastening systems are produced by Howmet Aerospace (the former Alcoa Fastening Systems), and Cherry blind rivets are a long-established aerospace fastener brand. These are consumable structural fasteners used across essentially every Western airframe, and they reach aircraft operated by India embedded in imported structures and repair supply chains. There is no meaningful standalone India defence footprint or discrete citable contract for these fastener brands, so this is recorded as an honest Tier C generic-component card.
